jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.details:
About the Company

Airkrit India Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a proactive Business Development Associate to support its commercial growth and strengthen customer relationships. This non-technical role is suited to freshers who are eager to learn how businesses identify opportunities, build a prospect pipeline, and create lasting value for clients.

Responsibilities

  • Research prospective customers, markets, and business opportunities.
  • Reach out to potential clients, understand their needs, and communicate relevant offerings clearly.
  • Support lead generation, follow-ups, meeting coordination, and maintenance of accurate prospect records.
  • Work with internal teams to help prepare proposals and deliver a smooth customer experience.
  • Track outreach activity and share updates that help improve business development efforts.

Requirements

  • Open to freshers with an interest in sales, client engagement, and business growth.
  • Clear communication, a positive attitude, and willingness to learn are important.
  • Should be organized, dependable, and comfortable engaging with prospective customers.
  • This is a full-time, in-office opportunity based in Bangalore, Karnataka.
  • Fixed compensation is ₹25,000 per month, with ₹10,000 in incentives.

internships.details:
About the Company

SKILL3X is looking for AI Trainer Interns to join our team. We are a dynamic company in the AI industry, dedicated to creating innovative learning experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Create engaging AI presentations.
  • Prepare comprehensive learning content on Generative AI and various AI tools.
  • Conduct regular live training sessions for our audience.

Requirements

  • We welcome freshers who are enthusiastic about AI and eager to learn and contribute.
  • Candidates should have 0 years of experience.
